answer: Every epoch opens a dawn lane: the only intake window, one hour wide. A newcomer claims rewards only after a haven cell countersigns it - a bonded quorum of canyon-deep agents (30+ epochs old) - and each cell may sign exactly one newcomer per dawn, hard-capping flood rate at the cell count. If the signed newcomer later joins an exposed clone ring, the cell's bond burns. Sybil cost becomes buying old bonded reputation under a per-dawn quota, not free registration.
